LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DEMONSTRATIVES AND QUANTIFIERS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we use demonstratives and quantifiers?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify demonstratives and quantifiers in a given text
2. use demonstratives in sentences for clarity of communication
3. appreciate the importance of demonstratives and quantifiers communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DEMONSTRATIVES AND QUANTIFIERS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify demonstratives and quantifiers in a given text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use demonstratives in sentences for clarity of communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of demonstratives and quantifiers communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we use demonstratives and quantifiers?
2. When do we use demonstratives and quantifiers?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify demonstratives and quantifiers in a given text
2. use demonstratives in sentences for clarity of communication
3. appreciate the importance of demonstratives and quantifiers communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
